entries.source:
Improve your fungus to allow it to take a part of any healing you receive and improve it.
		Each time you are healed you get a regeneration effect for 6 turns that heals you of %d%% of the direct heal you received.
		The effect will increase with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
强化你的孢子使其能够参与到你的治疗作用中。
		每当你受到治疗时，你会得到一个持续6回合的回复效果，回复值为你所受治疗值的 %d%%。
		效果受精神强度加成。

entries.source: It would go well with another part of Ureslak.
entries.target: 另一件乌尔斯拉克的遗物会增强它的能力。

entries.source: Stunning an opponent slows down their movement and reduces their damage output, giving you the opportunity to tactically reposition or finish them off at less risk.
entries.target: 震慑可以减缓目标的移动速度，降低其伤害输出，这样可以为你制造机会解决它们，或者降低他们对你的威胁。

entries.source:
Summons an ethereal magical eye at the designated location that lasts for %d turns.
		The eye cannot be seen or attacked by other creatures, and possesses magical vision that allows it to see any creature in a %d range around it.
		It does not require light to do so, but it cannot see through walls.
		Casting the eye does not take a turn.
		Only one arcane eye can exist at any given time.
		At level 4, if cast on a creature it will follow it until it expires, or until the creature dies.
		At level 5, it will place a magical marker on the creatures, negating invisibility and stealth effects.
entries.target:
召唤 1 个奥术之眼放置于指定地点，持续 %d 回合。
		此眼睛不会被其他生物看见或攻击，它提供魔法视觉，可看到它周围 %d 码范围的怪物。
		奥术之眼无需光照便能看见生物，但无法看穿墙壁。
		召唤奥术之眼不消耗回合。
		同时只能存在 1 个奥术之眼。
		在等级 4 时，可以在怪物身上放置奥术之眼，持续时间直到技能结束或怪物死亡。
		在等级 5 时，它可以在怪物身上放置一个魔法标记并无视隐形和潜行效果。

entries.source: Telos the Great and Powerful (reluctant follower of %s)
entries.target: 伟大而强大的泰勒斯 (%s不情愿的追随者)

entries.source: The shadow created by the fortress, it resembles somewhat the horrors you saw previously, but it is not the same.
entries.target: 堡垒制造的阴影，就像你之前看到的恐怖生物一样，不过显然它们有着本质的区别。

entries.source: A huge troll, he might move slowly but he does look dangerous nonetheless.
entries.target: 一只巨大的巨魔，虽然他行动缓慢，但是毫无疑问他看起来危险无比。

entries.source: Some notes describing how to create poison gas traps, left by an unfortunate rogue.
entries.target: 一些描述如何制造毒气陷阱的笔记，由一位不幸的盗贼留下。

entries.source: I am afraid this is not your lucky day then. The merchant is ours... and so are you! GET THIS INTRUDER!!
entries.target: 恐怕今天不是你的幸运日。那个商人是我们的了……你也是！拿下这个入侵者！！

entries.source: Aeryn said she would send troops to deal with it.
entries.target: 艾琳说她会派军队去处理。

entries.source: Enhance the power of your mind with gestures.
#00FF00#The elixir has improved your capacity for exercising your core talents.
entries.target: #00FF00#药剂提升了你核心技能的能力。
装备力量来源 #OLIVE_DRAB#自然力量#LAST#

entries.source:
Activate the rune to unleash a manasurge upon yourself, increasing mana regeneration by %d%% for %d turns (%d total) and instantly restoring %d mana.
			Also when resting your mana will regenerate at 0.5 per turn.
entries.target:
激活这个符文对你自己释放法力回复，增加法力回复 %d%%，持续 %d 回合（总计 %d），并立即回复 %d 点法力值。
			同时，在你休息时法力值每回合回复 0.5。

entries.source: Slings are used to hurl stones or metal shots at your foes.
entries.target: 投石索用来向敌人投掷石质或金属子弹。

entries.source: Spellhunter's Guide part 3: How to Kill a Magic-User
entries.target: 魔法猎手指南第三部分：如何杀死施法者

entries.source: A huge troll, he seems to be adapted to aquatic life.
entries.target: 一只巨大的巨魔，他似乎已经习惯了水中的生活。

entries.source:
Invokes a blast of shadows that deals %0.2f darkness damage, and leaves a radius 3 field that does %0.2f darkness damage per turn for %d turns.
		The damage dealt will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
引起一片暗影爆炸，对目标造成 %0.2f 点暗影伤害，并在 3 码半径范围的区域内每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Your dirges echo mournfully through the air.  When you end a dirge, you continue to gain its acolyte-level effects for %d turns.  You can only benefit from one such lingering dirge at a time.

Furthermore, you are given focus by the song.  Your dirges increase your resistance to confusion and fear by %d%%.
entries.target:
你的挽歌在周围回荡着悲伤。当你结束挽歌时，你持续获得其入门效果 %d 回合。你同时只能受到一种挽歌的余音效果。

而且歌声使得你更加专注。挽歌增加你 %d%% 的混乱和恐惧抗性。

entries.source: The orb seems to corrupt all it touches.
entries.target: 水晶球似乎能腐蚀一切。

entries.source: The target is hexed, creating an empathic bond with its victims. It takes %d%% feedback damage from all damage done.
entries.target: 目标受到邪术影响，与其受害者之间建立起共感联结。它所造成的全部伤害中有 %d%% 会作为反馈伤害返还其自身。

entries.target:
#{bold}#钢铁王座交易账簿——联合王国#{normal}#
#{italic}#卓越纪 121年#{normal}#

#{bold}#最后的希望——出口清单#{normal}#
      钢制板甲（人类）- 500pcs.
      钢制板甲（半身人）- 460pcs.
      钢制武器 -
      * 长剑 - 170pcs.
      * 长矛 - 200pcs.
      * 钉头锤 - 150pcs.
      工艺品、杂货 - 2,200pcs.

#{bold}#德斯镇——出口清单#{normal}#
      铁制手斧 - 50pcs.
      工具、杂货 - 65pcs.

#{bold}#最后的希望——进口清单#{normal}#
      黄金 - 500,000pcs.
      谷物等 - 1,000tons

#{bold}#机密事项：安格利文——出口#{normal}#
      石榴石 - 50pcs.
      红宝石 - 40pcs.
      钻石 - 20pcs.

今年钻石产量很低——加价50%？伊格兰斯袭击了我们上一支安格利文商队——增派守卫？——D·
钻石同意加价。武装商队里的商人，不增派守卫。利润已经够薄了！——S·。

entries.source: heal yourself and all friendly characters within 10 spaces for %d
entries.target: 治疗你自己和周围10格内的所有友方生物%d点生命值

entries.source: Killed Linaniil, the Supreme Archmage of Angolwen.
entries.target: 杀死安格利文的超阶魔导师莱娜尼尔。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You possess a control rod. You are the master.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你拥有一根控制棒，你就是主人。

entries.source:
Throw a knife coated with venom, doing %d%% damage as nature and inflicting additional effects based on your active vile poisons (as per the Venomous Strike talent):
		
		%s
		Using this talent puts your Venomous Strike talent on cooldown.
entries.target:
投掷一把剧毒飞刀，造成 %d%% 自然伤害并根据你当前生效的毒素造成中毒效果（和毒素爆发相同）:

		%s
		使用这技能将使毒素爆发进入冷却。

entries.source: All talents that can be used with Matrix.
entries.target: 所有可以被施展矩阵加速的技能。

entries.source: Small seeds seem to be growing inside the orb.
entries.target: 水晶球里面似乎生长着微小的种子。

entries.source:
You have saved the Iron Council from untold horrors from the deep.

You may now create female dwarf characters sporting proudly facial pilosity as is the norm in the upper classes of dwarven society.
This has no effect on gameplay at all but it is fun!

#LIGHT_GREEN#This is only available to donators. Thanks for your support!
entries.target:
你从来自地底的无数恐怖手中拯救了钢铁议会。

现在你可以创建骄傲地蓄着胡须的女性矮人；这在矮人社会的上层阶级中蔚然成风。
胡须完全不会影响游戏玩法，但很有趣！

#LIGHT_GREEN#此选项仅供捐赠者使用。感谢你的支持！

entries.source: Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.
entries.target: 在被复活之前，这位弓箭手的遗体上居然还保留着一张还不错的弓。你开始觉得，世界上如果有更多的盗墓贼就好了。
#LIGHT_BLUE#一个梦境之种从%s的沉眠中释放。

entries.source: Powers of the various objects of the world.
entries.target: 世界上各种物品的能力。

entries.source: Increases localized gravity, pulling in targets in a radius of %d.
entries.target: 增加周围的重力，吸引半径 %d 范围内的目标。
通用 提升寒冷抗性

entries.source: You may select a spell for Contingency to automatically use when your life falls below a percentage.  Only active spells that do not require a target may be chosen.
entries.target: 你可以为意外术选择一个法术：当你的生命值降到一定百分比以下时，它会自动施放。只能选择无需目标的主动法术。

entries.source: #Target# is free from the mental invasion.
This ancient Treant's bark is scorched almost black. It sees humanity as a scourge, to be purged.
entries.target: 这棵远古树人的树皮被烧得几乎焦黑。它视人类为必须清除的祸害。
